title: Local nonlinear half-cell flux theory audit on frozen C5I Reference trajectories
scientific_question: For the actual C5I prescribed-head bottom-state pairs, what part of the boundary response is explained by explicit time-level conductivity localization versus the nonlinear half-cell constitutive/spatial operator, and does a theory-derived local operator show a grid-consistent direction before any new dynamic Reference formulation is considered?

frozen_code_facts.headcalc_swkimpl0_face_conductivity: K_face at the lower boundary is K_N from time level t; it is not updated during Newton when swkimpl=0
frozen_code_facts.headcalc_last_cell_residual: the local lower-face contribution is +K_face*g in the last-cell residual
frozen_code_facts.legacy_adapter_qbot: after an accepted swbotb=5 solve, published qbot is materialized from qtop + source/sink terms + total storage change/dt rather than copied from the local face term
frozen_code_facts.implication: local discrete face flux and published mass-balance bottom flux must be diagnosed separately; their difference is controlled by the accepted equation residual rather than assumed identically zero

frozen_workload.compiler_route: O0 only; immutable C5I already established O0/O2 byte identity

pre_step: committed pre-step last-cell pressure head h_pre
post_step: accepted post-step last-cell pressure head h_post
published bottom outward exchange and terminal outward flux already present in LAREGW1_STATE
instrumentation.hard_identity_control: Every reconstructed LAREGW1_STATE line from the instrumented run must be byte-identical to the corresponding immutable C5I O0 baseline line at the same geometry/history/step.

constitutive_authority.rule: Reproduce the exact B1.10 provider water-content and conductivity functions for frozen B14, including the near-zero-head branch and Ksat cap. No fitted coefficient.

current_discrete_face.role: reconstruct the local lower-face term actually present in the frozen swkimpl=0 HeadCalc residual; compare separately with published mass-balance outward flux

post_cell_conductivity.role: isolates the effect of using post-step instead of explicit pre-step cell conductivity on the same frozen state pair

arithmetic_center_boundary.role: frozen-state constitutive diagnostic related to C5J K1, but not a dynamic rerun

integrated_linear_head.definition: K_int = integral(K(h) dh)/(h_post-hbot) for h_post != hbot, with the continuous limit K(h_post) when equal; Q_int = K_int * [1 + (h_post-hbot)/delta]
integrated_linear_head.role: Kirchhoff/integral conductivity mean under a linear pressure-head reconstruction across the half-cell; zero-fit spatial constitutive diagnostic

exact_steady_half_cell.definition: Use downward coordinate s from cell center to the prescribed boundary. Solve dh/ds = 1-Q/K(h), h(0)=h_post, h(delta)=hbot. Equivalently delta = integral from h_post to hbot of K(h)/(K(h)-Q) dh. Select the unique branch Q<min K when hbot>h_post, Q>max K when hbot<h_post, and Q=K(h) when equal.
exact_steady_half_cell.role: local steady nonlinear Darcy/Richards half-cell boundary-value diagnostic only; not assumed valid as a dynamic production closure

aggregation_and_metrics.aggregate_to_C5I_window: For every 0.0008-day window, average the sixteen T16 flux values, equivalent to summing their exchanges and dividing by 0.0008 day.
grid_metrics: R512-R1024 RMSE, signed mean and max absolute difference for each flux representation
RMSE norm and projection of each postprocessed correction relative to the current local-face inter-grid difference
published mass-balance inter-grid gap identity to C5I
local-face versus published-flux discrepancy at each grid

numerical_qualification.instrumentation_state_identity: byte exact on LAREGW1_STATE lines against immutable C5I
numerical_qualification.note: These are code/numerical-consistency tolerances only, not hydrological acceptance thresholds.
numerical_qualification.local_flux_reconstruction_basis: For the frozen no-source/sink C5I workload, summing the accepted HeadCalc residual telescopes to Q_current_face - Q_published. The D13 fallback total integrated residual gate is 1e-12 cm; at dt=5e-5 d this is 2e-8 cm/d. The 2.1e-8 gate adds only floating-output margin.

adjudication_rules.dynamic_followup_rule: A future dynamic Reference counterfactual requires a new preregistration and is authorized only if C5K shows a theory-derived, zero-fit operator with consistent mechanism direction across both grids and prescribed-head phases. C5K itself cannot admit such an operator.

stop_rules: No dynamic boundary counterfactual in C5K.
No fitted conductivity mean or empirical coefficient.
No LARE rerun or LARE closure change.
No application acceptance, performance, speed or production claim.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: logging-only C5I harness instrumentation and postprocessing theory diagnostics on frozen states
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: Reference solver/boundary changes, fitted conductivity means, response-driven formula changes, T32/R2048, LARE changes
